name: HFCL

snapshot.about: HFCL manufactures optical fiber, cables, connectivity solutions, and defense and aerospace equipment.

narrative: Management delivered strong Q2 FY27 revenue growth of ₹2,541.79 crore and net profit of ₹394.22 crore, raising FY27 revenue guidance to at least 80%. However, long-term cash conversion remains weak despite strong top-line targets.
